title: AI基礎(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: Basic Topics in Artificial Intelligence
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program
Mathematics and Science Courses
keywords: AI: Artificial Intelligence 2.Visual recognition 3.Natural language analysis 4.Interactive voice recognition 5.Machine learning
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) study the history of AI, and experience basic functions and practical examples of AI through active learning. (2) based on these experiences, learn state-of-the-art technology through various basic examples. (3) learn how image recognition, natural language processing, and interactive speech recognition can understand and manipulate basic contents.
advice: This is a basic course in AI. We will cover the following topics: 1. Basic mechanism of AI, basic and representative AI functions, and elementary theories of machine learning (deep learning). Through specific examples of AI functions, students will understand (1) to (3) and their basic operations. (1) Visual recognition. (2) Natural language processing. (3) Interactive voice identification. 2. The history of AI. 3. Legal compliance and ethical issues when using AI. (1) Compliance with laws and regulations such as the Personal Information Protection Act. (2) Regarding AI ethics as a broader standard than the law: Respect for ethics in the handling of information and data related to people. 4. The basic data structure necessary for AI machine learning and creating simple data. 5. Application examples of various AI functions in science and engineering.
books: Do not use textbooks. References will be given as appropriate in class.
requiredKnowledge: 1. An understanding of the basics of computer operation. 2. Since progress in this field is rapid and explanatory documents will not be immediately available, handouts will be distributed as the class progresses; students should have the ability to learn from the handouts. The latest reference books will be introduced as available. 3. The ability to write a report carefully and to adhere to a submission deadline

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand basic examples of AI image identification and perform basic operations.
Be able to understand basic examples of AI natural language processing.
Be able to understand basic examples of AI interactive voice recognition functions and perform basic operations.
Be able to understand the basic data structures necessary for machine learning and construct basic data.
Be able to understand history of AI, observe AI-related laws, and develop an attitude of respecting AI ethics.
Be able to attend every class, work on assigned tasks, and understand the contents of the class.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand and explain the history of AI and the basics of machine learning (deep learning). (2) Understand the basic mechanism of image identification and be able to operate it sufficiently. (3) Understand the basic mechanism of natural language processing and be able to operate it sufficiently. (4) Understand the basic mechanism of interactive voice recognition function and be able to operate it sufficiently. (5) Be able to prepare machine learning data according to the purpose. (6) Understand and comply with AI laws and regulations; deepen respect for AI ethics.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the history of AI and the basic contents of machine learning (deep learning) and be able to give an overview of them. (2) Understand and operate the basic mechanism of image identification. (3) Understand and operate the basic mechanism of natural language processing. (4) Understand and operate the basic mechanism of interactive voice recognition function. (5) Prepare the required amount of data for machine learning. (6) Understand and comply with AI laws and regulations; deepen respect for AI ethics.
